scripts.check: npm run build && cd pilot && npx hyperframes check
scripts.render:draft: npm run build && [ -f pilot/assets/bed.wav ] || npm run audio && node tools/render-chunks.mjs --name preview --samples 2 --scale 0.5 --quality draft
scripts.render:final: npm run build && [ -f pilot/assets/bed.wav ] || npm run audio && node tools/render-chunks.mjs --name final --samples 5 --scale 1 --quality delivery
scripts.render:gpu-4k60: npm run build && [ -f pilot/assets/bed.wav ] || npm run audio && cd pilot && npx hyperframes render --browser-gpu --gpu --fps 60 --quality delivery --variables '{"samples":12,"scale":2,"fps":60}' --player-ready-timeout 300000 --protocol-timeout 3600000 -o renders/pilot-4k60.mp4
